title: 收割機又來了
mood: a flirtation that comes back with the harvest
subject: the combine-harvester driver who comes through the village every June and the woman who brings him tea
caption: Northwest Chinese hua'er highland pop, a modern Hezhou-style folk song with a band. Opens with a free-time a cappella male call, then an acoustic guitar drone, a banhu answering each vocal phrase, a deep frame drum and hand drums in a loping four-four, a fingered bass and a sparse synth pad. Open and airy with an outdoor feel, the two voices and the banhu forward, the drums low and round. A male and a female voice singing a call-and-response duet in a high piercing head voice, with falsetto flips on long held vowels and ai-hai-yo vocables. Free-time intro, then 88 BPM, D major with a pentatonic melody. A harvest-season flirtation that comes back once a year. No guzheng, no guofeng orchestra, no Mongolian morin khuur, no Yunnan-style southwest folk-pop, no rock drum kit, no piano ballad, no trap drums, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - free-time a cappella male call, high falsetto]
哎 麥子黃了 收割機上山了喲

[Verse 1 - Male]
我開著收割機 從河州一路割上來
一年就來這一回 六月的日頭曬脫了皮
溝口數過來 第三塊是你家的地
地埂上的尕妹妹 提著一壺茶

[Verse 2 - Female]
阿哥你的機器聲 半個村子都聽見
我說是給你送茶 其實茶早就涼了
去年你說明年還來 我數了三百多天
今年你的帽子 怎麼換成紅的了

[Chorus - male calls, female answers, band enters]
收割機又來了 哎嗨喲
麥子一年黃一回 你一年來一回
你割完我家的 能不能走慢一點
尕妹妹 我的油門已經踩到最輕了

[Verse 3 - Male]
割完你家天黑了 你媽留我吃麵片
她看看我 又看看你 多舀一勺辣子
明天我要去下一條溝 下一個縣
我把手機號碼 寫在你家的麥袋上

[Chorus - male calls, female answers]
收割機又來了 哎嗨喲
麥子一年黃一回 你一年來一回
麥袋上的號碼 我已經存好了
明年六月不用等麥黃 我先打給你

[Outro - free-time female call over banhu, fading]
哎 阿哥的機器聲 翻過山梁了喲
